from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 8 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            pr0, pr1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            pc0, pc1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            ph, pw = pr1-pr0+1, pc1-pc0+1
            pattern = [[grid[pr0+i][pc0+j] for j in range(pw)] for i in range(ph)]
            for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                    out[y][x] = pattern[(y-pr0) % ph][(x-pc0) % pw]
    return out
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-8d753fba.py'
program_path.write_text(code)
print(program_path)
